errors.evidence: The description states the final data point for the 'Accuracy' line is at a question popularity of 25, but the plot shows this point is at question popularity 26.
The description states the final data point for the 'Confidence' line is at a question popularity of 25, but the plot shows this point is at question popularity 26.
The description states the final data point for the 'Alignment' line is at a question popularity of 25, but the plot shows this point is at question popularity 26.
The x-axis labels run from 5 to 25. While the last data point is at x=26, stating that the axis range extends to 26 is incorrect.
The term 'bemerkenswerten' (remarkable) is subjective and constitutes an interpretation of the data rather than a neutral description of the visual trend.
The dip in the 'Accuracy' line occurs at the data point with an x-coordinate of 14, not 13. There is no data point at x=13.
The 'Alignment' line starts at x=5 with a value of approximately 0.45. The stated value of 0.48 is an inaccurate approximation of the line's minimum value.

errors.text_span: wobei sie bei einer Beliebtheit von 10 einen Spitzenwert erreicht
errors.evidence: This statement incorrectly identifies the peak of the 'Alignment' line. While there is a local peak at x=10 (value ~0.65), the absolute peak occurs at x=18 with a higher value of approximately 0.73.

errors.text_span: und bei höheren Beliebtheitswerten allmählich abnimmt
errors.evidence: This is an incorrect generalization of the 'Alignment' line's trend. After the local peak at x=10, the line dips, then rises to an even higher peak at x=18 before it begins to decrease. Describing the trend after x=10 simply as a gradual decrease is factually wrong and misses a key feature of the data.
